ValidationRule.description: Closing Reason must be consistent with Status: only "Converted" is valid for Closed Won, and "Converted" is not valid for Closed Lost.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( AND( ISPICKVAL(Status, "Closed Won"), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Closing_Reason__c))), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Closing_Reason__c, "Converted")) ), AND( ISPICKVAL(Status, "Closed Lost"), ISPICKVAL(Closing_Reason__c, "Converted") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Closing Reason must be "Converted" for a Closed Won Lead, or a different reason for a Closed Lost Lead.
